- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** — builds `takeDown` verses starting from `startBottles`, inserting a blank line between verses (matching the expected output with `""` separators and no trailing blank).
- **`verse(n)`** — renders the 4 lines of a verse:
  - Lines 1–2: capitalized number + "green bottle(s) hanging on the wall,"
  - Line 3: the fixed "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,"
  - Line 4: "There'll be \<lowercase number\> green bottle(s) hanging on the wall."
- **`pluralFor(n)`** — handles the singular/plural distinction (`one green bottle` vs `no green bottles`).
- **`capitalize`** — title-cases the first rune via `unicode.ToTitle` (avoids the deprecated `strings.Title`; the test file's own `Title` copy stays unused but harmless since it's test-only).
